english.note: Use this specifically for a forecast of the weather.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a prediction of future weather.

examples.english: Today's weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 今日天氣預報話聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

examples.english: The weather forecast says it will rain in Hong Kong tonight, so remember to check it.
examples.traditional: 香港今晚會落雨，記得睇天氣預報。
examples.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 gam1 maan5 wui2 lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 tai2 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3
